steps.text: Ultrasound is sound above 20 kHz; its wavelength sets the imaging resolution.
Ultrasound reflects strongly at tissue boundaries; echo timing gives distance.
f = v/λ: shorter wavelength gives finer detail but shallower penetration.
X-rays are absorbed as I = I₀e^(−μx); denser tissue attenuates more.
The photoelectric effect dominates X-ray absorption in bone, giving contrast.
Half-value thickness is the thickness that halves the beam intensity.
